requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

1486-4231-4875-5361--108--119.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Conspiracy, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Auton Soldier. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Conspiracy, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

2760-4279-5931.easyPrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
2760-4279-5931.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Funeral Room triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
2760-4279-5931.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

950-2645-3147-3430.description:
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Azorius Chancery
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Fatestitcher.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

719-4881-6909-8198.manaNeeded: {4}{B}{G} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
719-4881-6909-8198.description:
Cast Trystan's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

4484-6440-6495.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
4484-6440-6495.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Ebondeath.
Repeat.
4484-6440-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

1981-2415-5231-6578.easyPrerequisites: You either have Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on the battlefield or have the emblem granted by Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel.
1981-2415-5231-6578.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Sephiroth and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Sephiroth trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

1870-4832-4873-5087.easyPrerequisites: Darksteel Reactor and Eternity Vessel have at least twenty charge counters combined.
1870-4832-4873-5087.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield.
1870-4832-4873-5087.description:
Use Ensoul Artifact to make Eternity Vessel a creature.
Cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield.
The Ozolith triggers, putting a number of charge counters on itself equal to the charge counters that were on Eternity Vessel.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving all counters from it onto Darksteel Reactor.
Darksteel Reactor triggers, causing you to win the game.

129-1978-5139-5793.description:
Activate Relic of Sauron by tapping it, adding two mana.
Kinnan triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Relic of Sauron which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.

1379-3003-4231-5966-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control enough artifacts to reduce Rory Williams's command tax to 0.
1379-3003-4231-5966-7824.description:
Cast Rory Williams by paying {W}{U}.
Rory Williams's last ability triggers, exiling it and creating two Food tokens, two Clue tokens, and two Treasure tokens.
Choose to return Rory Williams to the command zone from exile.
Sacrifice the two Treasure tokens for {W}{U}.
Repeat.

1987-3110-6991.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-3110-6991.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Donnie & April.
When Donnie & April enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-3110-6991.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

3249-5173-5921-6798.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater

7282-7340-7704.description:
Activate Doc Samson by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Sewer-veillance Cam.
When the Sewer-veillance Cam token enters, it triggers, untapping Doc Samson.
Repeat.

483-5220-6505-6900.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

3259-4053-4460-7604.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control with mana value 3 or less.
You either control another nontoken creature with mana value 3 or less, or have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4053-4460-7604.description:
Declare Excava and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Excava triggers, returning up to one creature with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to another creature with mana value 3 or less, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4053-4460-7604.notes: If both creatures used have haste, you can ignore the haste enabler.

2438-6871-6879-7223.description:
Cast Stalactite Dagger by paying {2}.
When Stalactite Dagger enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Shapeshifter creature token with changeling.
When the Shapeshifter enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Stalactite Dagger, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Stalactite Dagger.
When Stalactite Dagger dies, Haru triggers, returning Stalactite Dagger from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 once.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 4.

413-856-4321-6277.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
413-856-4321-6277.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar. Blasting Station and On Wings of Gold trigger.
Resolve the On Wings of Gold trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers. Resolve both triggers from this step and step 3, untapping it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

997-5058-7396.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2829-4559-5805-7306.easyPrerequisites: Two or more opponents have lost life this turn.
2829-4559-5805-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
2829-4559-5805-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gev.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-6972-7228.easyPrerequisites: There are two instant or sorcery cards in all graveyards.
413-6972-7228.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Academy Elite.
When Academy Elite dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Academy Elite enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

372-4125-7174.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Personify exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-4125-7174.description:
Cast Personify by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Shipwreck Dowser and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Shipwreck Dowser trigger.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Personify from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Personify.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Shipwreck Dowser and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

4331-4993-5116-5901.easyPrerequisites: Artist's Talent is at least level 2.
4331-4993-5116-5901.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

3967-4875-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
3967-4875-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-1358-1887-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Sydri
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

934-1399-1606-7069.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G} due to Tectonic Split
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and a land
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat

1115-1170-1329-1492.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1115-1170-1329-1492.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Welding Jar from your graveyard.
Cast Welding Jar by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2438-3174-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2086-2438-6824.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

565-1858-2427--118.notablePrerequisites:
You control an animated land without summoning sickness that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control a white permanent.
565-1858-2427--118.description:
Activate an animated land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast View from Above by paying {U}, targeting the animated land.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of the animated land that is not a creature.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

1339-2122-4050-4772.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2122-4050-4772.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Insect, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1306-1987-2468-3094.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Panoptic Mirror's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Panoptic Mirror's trigger, casting a copy of Ghostly Flicker without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Mana Crypt and Lithoform Engine.
Repeat from step 2.

224-1772-3756-5478.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

575-4771-5971.easyPrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
575-4771-5971.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Yedora triggers, returning Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Myr Scrapling enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Myr Scrapling by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Myr Scrapling face-up.
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability from step 1.
Repeat.

4659-5365-5366.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Clue.
4659-5365-5366.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Jenny Flint and Lonis' second ability trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Jenny Flint trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Repeat.
4659-5365-5366.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead sacrifice the Clues to their own abilities

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-943-983.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
74-943-983.description:
Activate Temple of the False God by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Temple of the False God.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Temple of the False God.
Repeat.
74-943-983.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other land except Temple of the False God instead.

1808-2837-2921.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1808-2837-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first Eloise trigger, creating either a 2/2 Cat or a 3/1 Dog creature token due to Jinnie Fay.
Resolve the second Eloise trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1322-3259-5722.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls no creatures.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature other than Wasitora.
1322-3259-5722.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent who controls no creatures using Wasitora and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Wasitora.
Resolve the Wasitora trigger, creating a 3/3 Cat Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat Dragon, then causing you to untap all creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat damage.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-413-3327.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
392-413-3327.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2178-4481-5368.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
2178-4481-5368.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1322-3259-3590.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Warchanter Skald has at least one Aura and/or Equipment attached.
1322-3259-3590.description:
Declare Warchanter Skald and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Dwarf Berserker token, untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

360-2034-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W/P}.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain one life.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it and Soul Warden trigger.
Resolve the Soul Warden trigger, causing you to gain one life.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Soldier, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

262-603-5147.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Galvanic Juggernaut.
Galvanic Juggernaut does not have summoning sickness.
262-603-5147.description:
Activate Galvanic Juggernaut by tapping it, creating five 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing an Elemental.
The Elemental dies, triggering Galvanic Juggernaut, untapping Galvanic Juggernaut.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1594-1661-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat
